# Calculus of Variations & First Integrals (Sec 9.1 – 9.3)

*   Read in parallel with Taylor. Directly covers first integrals when the integrand is independent of the dependent variable $f(y', x)$ and the Beltrami identity when it's independent of the independent variable $f(y, y')$.

# Constrained Variation & Isoperimetric Problems (Sec 9.4)

*   Mathematical formulation of Lagrange multipliers.
*   Dido's problem of maximum enclosed area with a fixed string length.
